title: BEST Course
description: Our biggest event. A 10 day feel-good summer course for European STEM-students. The academics, social activities, food and accommodation are organised by us.

title: Grow Your Future Track
description: 4-5 consecutive wednesday evenings where companies give talks to STEM-students to develop soft skills. After the talks, a reception takes place for networking.

title: Coding Challenge
description: An evening competition where students compete to complete as many difficult IT challenges as possible.

title: Game Jam
description: A 48-hour period where students create their own games from scratch. Coaches and keynotes are here during the whole weekend to guide them through this process.

title: ATHENS
description: An event partnered with KU Leuven. International students follow a one-week university course in STEM. BEST organises the social/cultural activities.
